items.docs:
### Sentiment Scores 

 Returns the daily sentiment scores of a given type for the specified companies over a period of time. The scores of up to 10 companies identified by their Bitvore ID (BvId) can be returned in a single call. The time period requested can be up to one year. The call options are: 
 * BvId - Up to 10 Bitvore ID's of companies to return scores for. 
 * Score - Type of score to return. Options are growth, risk, and sentiment (overall sentiment for a company). 
 * Start - First
